adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx the onSuccess callback is declared async but calls `utils.viewer.bookings.invalidate();` without awaiting/handling the returned promise. The diff shows this is a fire-and-forget async call; it’s not a clearly verifiable functional bug (React Query/TRPC invalidation typically doesn’t need awaiting for UI to update), but it is a concrete review issue because any rejection from `invalidate()` would be unhandled and it obscures sequencing intent. Using `await` or `void utils.viewer.bookings.invalidate()` would make the intent/handling explicit.
